about: The parts the question check must name when it refuses routing-2026-10-03.json with the mode at product-thinker (spc-2610030944505997 criterion A1): no chip header; one block, with no paragraph before the question and no Now: or Change later: line; the meaning of each option only in its preview, and so a side preview on each option (rule 14, the layout intent's decision 20); no decide-later option. Eleven parts break the rules. The refusal names one line per rule and tab (spc-2610301917245442, step 2), each naming the first part that broke the rule and counting the rest: six lines, holding five more parts (two more descriptions, the second missing line and two more previews).
